question: Is 136 games enough to certify anything?
why_it_matters: Every leaderboard and reward decision depends on it.
what_we_have: 136 official finals; 5,773 bets needed to separate 55% from 52.4% at 80% power.
how_to_resolve: Ingest prior seasons' official game logs, one page per week.

question: Which price is the benchmark for beating the market?
why_it_matters: CLV, edge and certification all depend on it.
what_is_missing: A dated, licensed operator price for opening and closing.
how_to_resolve: Subscribe to a licensed feed or store terms-permitted captures with timestamps.

question: May operator prices be scraped at all?
why_it_matters: If not, origination can never be scored against a market.
what_we_have: nfl.com pages only; no operator terms reviewed.
what_is_missing: The operator's terms of use for odds display.
how_to_resolve: Read the terms for one operator per jurisdiction and record the clause.

question: Is the negative home-field term real or an artefact?
why_it_matters: The frozen model uses a negative HFA (-0.50 pts).
what_we_have: 2026 weeks 1-9 mean home margin is -0.50 pts with n=136.
what_is_missing: A multi-season mean to compare against.
how_to_resolve: Compute the same statistic on prior seasons from official finals.

question: Does the report page timestamp its own publication?
why_it_matters: A delta needs a clock that is not ours.
what_we_have: No timestamp visible on the Week 11 report page.
what_is_missing: Publisher-side timestamps or page hashes over time.
how_to_resolve: Capture the same URL daily and hash it; treat any hash change as a revision.

question: Which clubs publish a machine-readable depth chart?
why_it_matters: G5 needs one route verified for all 32 clubs.
what_we_have: 0 of 32 verified in this namespace; the Texans publish an image and the Packers prefix jersey numbers.
how_to_resolve: Audit each club page, store the raw string, and record which parse worked.

question: Do official snap counts exist as a public page?
why_it_matters: If yes, depth can be derived from playing time instead of jersey order.
what_is_missing: One official snap-count source for any single week.
how_to_resolve: Locate the league's snap-count page (if published) and capture one week.

question: What does Questionable actually mean in 2026?
why_it_matters: It is the only forward-looking designation and its meaning is assumed.
what_we_have: 16 of 253 report rows carry a game designation at all; none joined to an inactive list.
what_is_missing: Multiple seasons of designations joined to inactive lists.
how_to_resolve: Archive reports and inactive lists, then compute the play rate per designation with CIs.

question: Do the three Lions designations really read Out?
why_it_matters: The brief asserts it; the page read here does not show it.

what_is_missing: The source page that prints Out for all three.

question: Which Week 11 fixture list is authoritative for venues?
why_it_matters: Two official pages disagree on one stadium name.
what_we_have: The game centre prints NORTHWEST STADIUM for Commanders home games; the schedule page's ticket link says FedEx Field.
what_is_missing: A league statement renaming the stadium.

question: Can a parlay leg covariance be estimated from official data alone?
why_it_matters: Multipliers are only valid with a joint probability.
what_we_have: Cross-game and margin/total correlations are computable (n=136); player-prop pairs are not.
what_is_missing: A prop market feed to define the legs.
how_to_resolve: Buy or license a feed; until then keep S5/S6 blocked.

question: How many trials have we actually run?
why_it_matters: Multiplicity adjustment needs the count, including abandoned variants.
what_we_have: 6 pre-registered strategies; earlier desks recorded additional variants.
what_is_missing: A single ledger of every variant ever tried across sessions.
how_to_resolve: Consolidate all session strategy ledgers into one register.

question: Does the 2026 rule book create a priors problem?
why_it_matters: Kickoff and onside-kick rules change totals and late-game win probability.
what_we_have: No 2026 rule-book text read in this session.
how_to_resolve: Read the rule book and record the changed clauses with page numbers.

question: Should the totals model keep two estimators or drop one?
why_it_matters: R13 asks for both until one wins.
what_we_have: Both lose to a constant league-mean total on the Week 10 holdout (skill -0.121 and -0.084).
how_to_resolve: Re-run weekly; drop an estimator only when it loses over >= 100 scored totals.

question: Who owns the reward pool and the amounts?
why_it_matters: The leaderboard cannot pay out without a defined pool.
what_is_missing: A funded pool and payout rules.
